# iqcommune

> iqcommune connects you with working finance professionals for small, in-person sessions — real insight from people still in the field, not full-time trainers.

iqcommune — insight quotient unleashed. Real financial insights from active professionals, backed by years of experience. Built for anyone serious about financial literacy. All practitioners are currently active in the domain they teach. Sessions are in-person only, capped at 25 participants.

## What makes it different

A practitioner is not a trainer. Conventional trainers teach theory only, from outdated curricula and generic case studies, and the learning ends in the classroom. iqcommune practitioners blend theory with practice, teach from updated content and real portfolio examples, manage money the same way they teach you to, and leave attendees with a real action plan. Every module is not a certificate programme — it ends in a concrete deliverable built with the attendee's own numbers (a personal budget framework, a retirement corpus number, a stock evaluation template, a debt allocation framework, a model portfolio structure, a mutual fund shortlist framework).

## How a session gets booked (learner side)

1. Pick a topic — choose one module, or a 6-hour bundle covering two related modules.
2. Join the waitlist — share your audience type and group size (up to 25); nothing is scheduled yet.
3. iqcommune maps your city — practitioners are empanelled city by city, and you're contacted once matched.
4. Attend the session — in-person, max 25 participants, led by an active practitioner.

## Who sessions are for

- **Groups** — friends & family, colleagues, residential communities, walking/interest groups, study circles. One point of contact registers for the whole group.
- **Organisations & institutions** — corporates, educational institutions, hospitals, media & production — tailored upskilling.
- **AMCs & wealth firms** — client education, new-joiner onboarding, RM/advisor upskilling, investor awareness events.

## Training modules

1. Foundations of Personal Finance
2. Retirement & Goal-Based Financial Planning
3. Equity Investing Simplified
4. Debt & Fixed Income Investing
5. Asset Allocation & Portfolio Construction
6. Investment Solutions & Portfolio Strategies

Any two related modules can be taught back-to-back by one practitioner as a single 6-hour (3hrs+3hrs) bundled session, open to all audience types. Fixed pairings: Foundations + Retirement, Equity + Debt, Asset Allocation + Investment Solutions. Bundled sessions need a minimum of 9 participants (vs. 5 for a single module).

## Policies

- Practitioners never sell or cross-sell financial products during a session (firm policy).
- iqcommune is an independent platform, not affiliated with AMFI, SEBI, or any product entity — it teaches frameworks, not stock tips.
- In-person only; no online sessions.
- Venue is arranged by whoever is booking (Groups, Organisations, or AMCs each arrange their own venue).
- Registration is per group, via one SPOC (single point of contact).

## Who teaches (practitioner network)

Practitioners are working finance professionals with a minimum of 5 years of active, hands-on experience — employed or independent. Eligible roles: Equity Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Certified Financial Planners (SEBI-registered), Wealth Advisors & RMs, Fund & Product Specialists / MFDS, Corporate Finance Professionals.

**Good fit:** actively practising in finance today; comfortable talking about your own work unscripted; wants side income with zero business development; available at least once every few months, reliably; comfortable with the disclosure terms below.
**Not a fit:** left finance for full-time training; wants to pitch or sell products during sessions; wants guaranteed monthly income; unreliable availability; under 5 years of experience.

**Division of work** — practitioner brings: hands-on expertise, real examples, willingness to take questions, confirmed availability, no product cross-selling. iqcommune handles: client acquisition and marketing, attendance enforcement via the SPOC, all SPOC coordination, scheduling/confirmations/logistics, fee collection and revenue-share payout.

**Process:**
1. Apply in 5 minutes (role, experience, module, why).
2. iqcommune reaches out within 2–3 working days for an informal fit check.
3. Matched to a module; availability confirmed per session.
4. Teach and earn — revenue share paid after each confirmed session.

**Compensation:** revenue share per session; the exact percentage is confirmed during onboarding, before any commitment, and varies by session type/audience/format — practitioners always know the amount before confirming. Payment and invoicing setup is handled separately, after empanelment. No upfront fees, ever, and no sales work required.

**Disclosure/privacy:** never made public — full name, employer, personal contact details, photos, profiles, or endorsements. Shared only on a confirmed session, with consent — first name only, years of experience/domain, organisation or practice name (or "independent practitioner"), and an iqcommune coordination contact (not the practitioner's personal number). Practitioners keep zero public exposure and control what's shared; identity is naturally visible to attendees once in the room for a confirmed session. Practitioners remain free to run independent sessions elsewhere (non-exclusive), no prep or slides are required, they can apply to teach multiple modules, and post-session contact with attendees is entirely the practitioner's own call — no bulk collection or pitching during the session itself.
